data.title: Bojná – the life of the Slavs on the hillfort in winter
data.excerpt: The lads from the Herjan group found out for themselves what life was like on the snow-covered and frozen hillfort at Bojná.
data.metaTitle: Bojná – Slavic life on the hillfort in winter
data.metaDescription: Members of the Herjan group found out for themselves what life was like in winter on the snow-covered and frozen Great Moravian hillfort at Bojná.
